metrics.qed_mean: mean RDKit QED among valid molecules; higher is favorable
metrics.raw_rdkit_sa_mean: mean RDKit synthetic accessibility among valid molecules; lower is favorable

analysis: primary, extension and pooled six-seed mean and sample SD by model and model-pocket cell

per model-pocket reconstruction-error counts and rates
